item.title: Ambiq launches heliaPROFILER to speed Edge AI development
item.summary: Ambiq has launched heliaPROFILER, an open-source profiling tool designed to help developers analyze and optimize AI workloads running on its Apollo system-on-chips. The tool adds cycle-accurate profiling, memory analysis and optional real-time power measurement to Ambiq’s HELIA AI software ecosystem.
